# Israel-Gaza war

[![Close up of Benjamin Netanyahu from the shoulders up. He has short, grey hair and is wearing a shirt, tie and suit.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/1688/live/5a6f2b30-94c1-11f1-adb5-bd19050a74a5.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Netanyahu's rejection of Trump's 15-point Gaza plan unlikely to be final word**\\
\\
The Trump administration is said to be unbothered by the Israeli prime minister's rejection of the deal, viewing it as campaign rhetoric ahead of a general election.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce3q5282ep3o)

[![Displaced Palestinians walk between destroyed houses in Jabaliya, northern Gaza City, 07 August 2026. ](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/449b/live/1de67870-93f5-11f1-a10f-45ed743c6e4b.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says**\\
\\
Israel's PM says its military will not pull out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yw4lpe0yeo)

[![](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/images/ic/480x270/p0p2y59x.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Will Hamas actually disarm?**\\
\\
Trump hailed the Board of Peace deal as a, "major milestone". Why has progress stalled?](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/play/w3ct8mfm)

[![A boy crouching besides rows of stretchers draped in Palestinian flags  containing the remains of 112 victims of an isreali strike in November 2023 at a Mass funerla held on 4th August 2026](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/566e/live/875b67e0-901a-11f1-a7ab-8b30adf0800a.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Mass funeral in Gaza for 112 Palestinians killed in 2023 Israeli strike**\\
\\
The bodies - belonging to members of two extended families - have only recently been recovered from under rubble in Gaza City.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn0n99npjejo)

[![A Palestinian man works on a laptop on a chair outside, surrounded by rubble, in Gaza ](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/711d/live/8600d9a0-8f59-11f1-9c32-a3e1fce5018b.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**'Digital lifeline' - Gaza tech workers give glimpse of possible future**\\
\\
Thousands of young people in Gaza are pursuing roles in the digital economy as the territory's wider recovery stalls.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1m1xm8ykk2o)

[![Massive Attack band members holding Palestine flag on stage in Singapore](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/bed0/live/bd25f770-8f00-11f1-b2ab-0dd01740f9f6.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Singapore bans Massive Attack over Palestine display**\\
\\
The UK band says they are "surprised and disappointed" by their treatment over shouting "free Palestine" at a concert in Singapore.](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/cp8xwdg4xl8o)

[![Two men search through rubble ](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/be84/live/aa736060-8e72-11f1-b2ab-0dd01740f9f6.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**At least 13 killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal**\\
\\
Israel says it was targeting military operatives in the strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czjlvvkzj20o)

[![FILE PHOTO: Hamas militants celebrate what they say is a victory over Israel after an eight-day conflict during a rally in the northern Gaza Strip November 22, 2012](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/c578/live/0117af90-8d22-11f1-8806-e38839242051.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Israeli official says troops won't pull back in Gaza without 'genuine' Hamas disarmament**\\
\\
Donald Trump insists Israel is "very happy" with a proposal for the Palestinian group to give up weapons in exchange for an Israeli withdrawal.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cd9wjj4qleeo)

[![A landscape shows sheer destruction across Gaza. Rubble, dust and dirt. ](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/20cd/live/e63e0bc0-8cf8-11f1-adaf-fb8940306590.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**What's in the Gaza peace deal roadmap?**\\
\\
Hamas says it has accepted a disarmament plan for Gaza which will see it lay down its arms and Israeli troops withdraw from the territory.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20e94k2ex5o)

[![Palestinians in Gaza retrieve belongings after Israeli air strike](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/42f6/live/6014fc90-8d0f-11f1-8134-83693cbcd5a0.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Bowen: Plan for Hamas to disarm faces big obstacles, yet it offers rare hope for Gaza**\\
\\
The realities of politics, war, zero trust, the deaths of thousands and the destruction of Gaza will make any agreement very complicated.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2dkje4p4klo)

[![Members of Hamas' Al-Qassam Brigades gather  wearing green Hamas bandanas and balaclavas sat on a jeep with guns in the air, in Gaza in 2025](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/480/cpsprodpb/d41c/live/07a56560-8cc2-11f1-a7ab-8b30adf0800a.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Israeli official says troops won't pull back in Gaza without 'genuine' Hamas disarmament**\\
\\
Announcing an agreement late on Thursday, Donald Trump said it was "a critical step towards Gaza finally being governed by a new Palestinian government".](https://www.bbc.com/news/live/clyp18kwdnwt)

[![Shaimaa Khalil wearing a blue shirt](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/56ae/live/fde4b0d0-8cad-11f1-b2ab-0dd01740f9f6.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**What are the next steps if Hamas is to disarm?**\\
\\
US President Donald Trump says an agreement has been reached for the "complete disarmament" of Hamas in Gaza.](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/ckg4ex78gpko)
